name: Select
description: AI agent orchestration with checked results, human approvals and autonomy agents earn.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/), Select's files and its encryption key (select/secret.key) and the database password (state/). Back up the whole folder: without secret.key, saved provider keys and mailbox passwords can't be read.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Select web app (it passes /api on to the API), published on host as 6702

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Select at, like http://192.168.1.20:6702 or https://select.example.com. Select works from any address; this one is used in invitation links, and with https the sign-in cookie is marked secure.
